description: Real geographical boundary data for India (states/UTs) and Tamil Nadu (districts, assembly constituencies, parliamentary constituencies). All files are GeoJSON FeatureCollections (EPSG:4326 / WGS84, coordinates rounded to 1e-4 deg).

extraProps: st_code (Census 2011 state code, string e.g. '33' for Tamil Nadu)
india-states.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/udit-001/india-maps-data/main/geojson/india.geojson (760 district features with st_nm/st_code, year=2011_c), dissolved by st_nm with mapshaper
notes: 36 states+UTs (28 states, 8 UTs) with CURRENT boundaries: Telangana and Ladakh present, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu merged, Jammu and Kashmir as UT.
State names use current official spellings: Odisha (not Orissa), 'Andaman and Nicobar Islands', 'Jammu and Kashmir', 'Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu'.
Full-precision census boundaries, no simplification needed (94 KB).
names: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

namingVariants.note: source spellings differ from the official 38 list for 3 districts; match case-insensitively after removing non-letters

missingVsOfficial38: Mayiladuthurai (created 28-Dec-2020 from Nagapattinam; NOT present in any open GeoJSON found — it remains merged inside the 'Nagapattinam' polygon)
notes: 37/38 official districts present (all 2019-2020 reorganised districts incl. Chengalpattu, Ranipet, Tenkasi, Kallakurichi, Tirupathur are present and separate).
Only Mayiladuthurai is absent. If a Mayiladuthurai shape is required, it must be sourced separately (e.g. TN govt / Survey of India); Nagapattinam polygon currently covers that area.
No better open source found: datameet Census_2011 set has only 32 older districts; geoBoundaries ADM2 (735 feats) is Census-2011 vintage with no state attribute.

tamil-nadu-ac.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datameet/maps/master/assembly-constituencies/India_AC.shp (ECI delimitation-based; STATUS field empty for TN => post-delimitation boundaries)
notes: All 234 TN ACs present, AC_NO unique 1..234, every AC carries its parent PC (all 39 PCs referenced).
AC names include reservation tags e.g. 'Ponneri (SC)', spacing/style varies (e.g. 'Thiru-Vi-Ka-Nagar(SC)').
Boundaries are delimitation-era (2008); some shift vs current ground (datameet README notes 'some shift in the data').
PC_NAME uses ALL CAPS (e.g. 'TIRUVALLUR (SC)') and PC_NO for joining to tamil-nadu-pc.geojson.
All 39 TN PCs present, pc_no 1..39 (matches ECI numbering; pc_no 1 = Thiruvallur, 39 = Kanyakumari).
Source spells PC 28 as 'Mayiladuturai' (official ECI spelling is 'Mayiladuthurai') and uses 'Thoothukudi', 'Thiruvallur', 'Thiruvarur'.

joinKeys.statesToDistricts: tamil-nadu-districts.geojson has no st_nm, but every feature belongs to Tamil Nadu (st_code 33 in source); india-states 'st_nm' = 'Tamil Nadu'.
joinKeys.districtsToState: Single-state file; join on constant 'Tamil Nadu'.
